facts.text: Faheem has shipped production code in Python, PHP and JavaScript, and worked with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and SQL Server along the way.
Every subdomain of faheemnaeem.dev runs on the Cloudflare Workers free plan, so the monthly hosting bill is $0.
The main site is a retro desktop on a 3D computer monitor, complete with Oregon Trail, Doom, Scrabble and a word game.
Faheem works from Calgary, Alberta, on Mountain Time (America/Edmonton).
Faheem holds a B.S. in Computer Science and an M.S. in Data Science, and added a SAIT certificate in 2026.
Long before LLM workflows, one of Faheem's early projects was a Django tool for bidding on Freelancer.com projects.
Faheem has built software for e-commerce, finance, real estate, healthcare, education and vending.
